family: profit-lock quote-harvest (net-replacement entry + break-even + one-way profit floor)
note: NEW instrument. V1/V2/V3 stay frozen and untouched. Rule motivated by a V2/V3 diagnostic; params are round a-priori numbers, adjudicated only by fresh forward data + the promotion gate. PAPER: no orders/wallet/SOL/on-chain, free data only.

sizing.model: forward arms at V1-comparable fraction; staged $10+$10 / 20%-settled capacity-capped is the intended LIVE sizing, gated on V4 proving positive

kill_switch.rule: HALT if, after n>=N_min resolved PASS trades, upper95(log-growth g) < 0 OR dump_rate >= dump_rate_max

promotion_criteria: positive log-growth after ALL costs (curve fees, ATA rent, real-size slippage, failed-landing fees)
positive per UTC day AND per creator-cluster
not carried by a single >=7x winner (drop-the-max robust)
unexitable rate under the B20B baseline
survives a fresh hash-frozen confirmation period never seen

benchmarks.score: pot growth G = sum ln(1 + position_fraction * stressed_net_return); dump-rate is a hard kill-gate, not the score
benchmarks.null: control = a material cluster sell fired but NET replacement was NOT confirmed; scored identically -> G_control
benchmarks.honest_prior: ~0 or small-positive; V3 plain trail was the best arm; V4 tests whether a break-even profit-lock stops green trades round-tripping to a loss without capping runners
